listing.name: Perimeter (Perimeter community engine)
listing.summary: Research listing. Upstream route: Open-source engine supports both games and original data; current source development. Limits: Observed GitHub release has no binaries; official Steam edition separate, macOS and some behavior experimental. Upstream platforms: Desktop source build for Windows/Linux, experimental macOS. Observed GitHub release lacks binaries; selected host CPU matrix unknown in frozen research. Original data: Supply purchased Perimeter game resources (models, textures, sounds, texts and configuration files) from the appropriate physical/digital release. Point the engine at that game content; do not assume the other Perimeter title supplies this target. Exact retail edition/patch/localization and any shared-base requirement remain Unknown in the retained README. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
